blocks.text: at / on / in: vaqtning «o'lchami»

Vaqt predloglarining asosiy mantig'i qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 103-dars): soat va aniq nuqta — **at**, kun va sana — **on**, oy, yil, fasl va uzun davr — **in**. O'zbekchada bularning hammasi bitta `-da` bilan aytiladi: soat besh**da**, juma**da**, may**da**. Shuning uchun o'zbekcha gap predlog tanlashda yordam bermaydi — vaqtning «o'lchami» haqida o'ylash kerak: u **nuqtami**, **bitta kunmi** yoki ichida yashash mumkin bo'lgan **davrmi**? Bu darsda asoslarni takrorlamaymiz, balki B1–B2 darajada chalkashtiriladigan holatlarni ko'ramiz: bayramlar (at Christmas / on Christmas Day), at night / in the night, on the morning of ..., predlogsiz iboralar va **in** + muddat.

rows: soat 6:15 da, tushda, tushlik paytida, kun botganda, hozir
**on** Monday, **on** 3 May, **on** my birthday, **on** Friday evening
dushanba kuni, 3-mayda, tug'ilgan kunimda, juma kuni kechqurun

blocks.text: at: kun nuqtalari, bayram davri va «o'sha payt»

**at** faqat soat bilan emas, kunning **nuqta** sifatida tasavvur qilinadigan paytlari bilan ham keladi: **at** noon, **at** midnight, **at** lunchtime, **at** dinner time, **at** bedtime, **at** sunrise / **at** sunset, **at** dawn. Bundan tashqari turg'un iboralar bor: **at the moment** va **at present** (hozir), **at the time** (o'sha paytda — o'tmish haqida), **at the same time** (bir vaqtda), **at the weekend** / **at weekends** (British English; amerikachasi — on the weekend). Ularning hammasida vaqt cho'zilgan davr emas, bitta «belgi» sifatida ko'riladi.

Bayramlarda nozik farq bor. Bayram **davri** — bir necha kunlik mavsum sifatida — **at** bilan: **at** Christmas, **at** Easter, **at** New Year. Bayramning **aynan o'zi**, ya'ni bitta kun esa, boshqa har qanday kun kabi **on** bilan: **on** Christmas Day, **on** New Year's Eve, **on** Independence Day. O'zbekchada farq so'z bilan beriladi: «Yangi yil **bayramida**» — at New Year, «31-dekabr **kuni**» — on New Year's Eve.

rows: **on** New Year's Day, **on** New Year's Eve
dam olish kunlari / shanba, yakshanba kuni

items.text: Sorry, Mr Brown is busy **at the moment** — can I take a message?
items.translation: Kechirasiz, janob Braun **hozir** band — biror gap yetkazib qo'yaymi?

items.text: We visit my uncle in Bukhara **at New Year**, and **on New Year's Eve** we watch the fireworks.
items.translation: **Yangi yil bayramida** Buxorodagi tog'amnikiga boramiz, **31-dekabr kuni** esa mushakbozlik tomosha qilamiz.

items.text: **At the time** of the interview, I had no idea how big the company was.
items.translation: Suhbat **paytida** kompaniya qanchalik katta ekanini bilmasdim.

blocks.text: on: aniq kun — hatto kun qismi bilan ham

Kun qismlari odatda **in** bilan: **in** the morning, **in** the evening. Lekin kun qismi **aniq bir kunga** bog'lansa, butun ibora o'sha kunga aylanadi va **on** ishlatiladi: **on** Friday morning, **on** the morning of 12 March, **on** the evening of the concert, **on** a hot summer afternoon, **on** a rainy day. Xuddi shunday: **on** my first day at work, **on** my wedding day, **on** that occasion. Mantiq oddiy: ibora «**qaysi kun?**» savoliga javob bo'lsa — **on**.

items.text: **On the evening of** the final, the streets of Tashkent were completely empty.
items.translation: Final **kuni kechqurun** Toshkent ko'chalari butunlay bo'shab qoldi.

items.text: I work best **in the morning**, but **on Monday mornings** I'm always slow.
items.translation: Men **ertalab** eng yaxshi ishlayman, lekin **dushanba kunlari ertalab** doim sust bo'laman.

items.text: We met **on a rainy afternoon** in Oxford and have been friends ever since.
items.translation: Biz Oksfordda **yomg'irli kunlarning birida tushdan keyin** tanishganmiz va o'shandan beri do'stmiz.

blocks.text: in: o'n yilliklar, asrlar va «ertaga ertalab»

**in** ichida yashash mumkin bo'lgan har qanday davr bilan keladi: **in** the 1990s (1990-yillarda), **in** the 15th century, **in** the Middle Ages (o'rta asrlarda), **in** the past (ilgari), **in** the future (kelajakda), **in** the summer holidays. Fasllar artikl bilan ham, artiklsiz ham: **in** (the) winter. Oy va yil birga kelsa ham **in**: **in** March 2026; kun qo'shilsa — **on**: **on** 8 March 2026. Nozik nuqta: kelasi zamon gapida **in the morning** ko'pincha «**ertaga ertalab**» ma'nosini beradi: I'll ring you **in the morning** — Senga ertaga ertalab qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
at night yoki in the night?

**at night** — umuman, odatda «kechalari»: Owls hunt **at night**. **in the night** (yoki **during the night**) esa **bitta aniq kechaning ichida** sodir bo'lgan voqea: I woke up **in the night** — kechasi uyg'onib ketdim. Hafta kuni bilan — **on** Saturday night; bugungi kecha — **tonight**, o'tgan kecha — **last night** (predlogsiz). O'zbekchada hammasi «kechasi», shuning uchun inglizchada qaysi kecha nazarda tutilayotganini aniqlab oling.
Predlogsiz: next, last, this, every — va yana boshqalar

Qizil kitobdan ma'lumki, **next**, **last**, **this**, **every** oldidan predlog qo'yilmaydi. Aslida bu ro'yxat uzunroq: **each** (each summer), **one** (one day — bir kun kelib), **that** (that evening — o'sha oqshom), **all** (all day — kun bo'yi), **the next day** (ertasi kuni), **the day before** (bir kun oldin), **yesterday / tomorrow** + kun qismi (yesterday afternoon, tomorrow morning). Diqqat: **on Friday** — eng yaqin juma, **next Friday** esa ko'pincha **kelasi haftaning** jumasi. Anglashilmovchilik bo'lmasligi uchun inglizlar ko'pincha «**this** Friday or **next** Friday?» deb aniqlashtirib oladi.
So'zlashuvda hafta kuni oldidan **on** ba'zan tushib qoladi: See you **Monday**! Bu ko'proq amerikacha uslub. British English da va yozuvda **on** Monday deb yozing.
in + muddat: «...dan keyin» va «...da bajardi»

**in** + vaqt miqdori ikki ma'noga ega. 1) Kelajakda — **hozirdan boshlab** shuncha vaqt o'tgach: **in** ten minutes, **in** a week's time, **in** three months' time (`'s time` bilan shakli aniqroq). 2) Biror ishni bajarishga **ketgan vaqt**: I wrote the report **in** two hours — hisobotni ikki soat**da** yozdim. **after** + muddat esa asosan o'tmishdagi voqealar ketma-ketligida: **After** two hours, they let us go. **for** — davomiylik (→ 119-dars), **within** — «... ichida, undan kechiktirmay».

rows: hozirdan ikki soat o'tgach / ikki soatda bajarildi
The train leaves **in** two hours. I painted the room **in** two hours.

items.text: The bank will transfer the money **in three working days**.
items.translation: Bank pulni **uch ish kunidan keyin** o'tkazib beradi.

items.text: Madina read the whole novel **in one weekend** — she couldn't put it down.
items.translation: Madina butun romanni **ikki kunlik dam olishda** o'qib tugatdi — undan ajrala olmadi.

items.text: **After ten minutes** the teacher came back, and the test continued.
items.translation: **O'n daqiqadan so'ng** o'qituvchi qaytib keldi va test davom etdi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «in Christmas Day» → **on Christmas Day**; «on Christmas» (bayram davri) → **at Christmas**; «in the weekend» → **at the weekend**; «in Friday evening» → **on Friday evening**; «at the night» → **at night**; «in 5 May» → **on 5 May**; «on next week», «in last year» → **next week**, **last year**; «in the next day» → **the next day**; kelajak haqida «I'll come back after ten minutes» → **in ten minutes**.

Uch savol bilan tekshiring: 1) Iborada **next / last / this / every / that / one** bormi? — predlog yo'q. 2) «**Qaysi kun?**» ga javobmi (sana, hafta kuni, aniq bir kunning ertalabi)? — **on**. 3) Ichiga sig'adigan davrmi (oy, yil, asr, kun qismi)? — **in**; nuqta yoki turg'un iborami? — **at**.
Bog'lanish: on time / in time, at the end / in the end — 122-dars; during, for, while — 119-dars; by va until — 120-dars; for va since — 12-dars; joy predloglari in / at / on — 123–125-darslar.
Xulosa

examples.title: **at**: exact points — **at** lunchtime, **at** sunset
examples.description: Soat va kunning nuqta sifatida ko'riladigan paytlari: at noon, at midnight, at lunchtime, at bedtime, at dawn, at sunset.

sentences.text: The museum closes **at half past five**, so we'd better hurry.
sentences.translation: Muzey **soat besh yarimda** yopiladi, shuning uchun shoshilganimiz ma'qul.

sentences.text: Dilnoza usually goes for a walk in the park **at lunchtime** to clear her head.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza odatda fikrini tiniqlashtirish uchun **tushlik paytida** bog'da sayr qiladi.

sentences.text: We climbed the hill to take photos of Samarkand **at sunrise**.
sentences.translation: Samarqandni **quyosh chiqayotganda** suratga olish uchun tepalikka chiqdik.

sentences.text: **At midnight** the whole street came out to watch the fireworks.
sentences.translation: **Yarim tunda** butun mahalla mushakbozlikni tomosha qilish uchun ko'chaga chiqdi.

sentences.text: Fishermen on the lake start work **at dawn**, when the water is still calm.
sentences.translation: Ko'ldagi baliqchilar ishni suv hali sokin bo'lgan **tong saharda** boshlaydi.

sentences.text: What time does your flight to London leave? — **At ten past six** in the morning.
sentences.translation: Londonga reysingiz soat nechada uchadi? — Ertalab **oltidan o'n daqiqa o'tganda**.

sentences.text: Our team has a short online meeting **at nine sharp** every Monday.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz har dushanba **roppa-rosa to'qqizda** qisqa onlayn yig'ilish o'tkazadi.

sentences.text: The old streets of Bukhara look magical **at sunset**, when the domes turn gold.
sentences.translation: Buxoroning eski ko'chalari **kun botayotganda**, gumbazlar oltin rangga kirganda, sehrli ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Sarah takes her medicine **at bedtime** because it makes her sleepy.
sentences.translation: Sara dorisini **yotish oldidan** ichadi, chunki u uyqu keltiradi.

sentences.text: Kate's shift finishes **at eleven at night**, so she always takes a taxi home.
sentences.translation: Keytning smenasi **kechasi soat o'n birda** tugaydi, shuning uchun u doim uyga taksida qaytadi.

examples.title: **at** Christmas, **at** the weekend, **at** the time
examples.description: at bilan turg'un iboralar: at the weekend / at weekends, at Christmas, at New Year (bayram davri), at the moment, at present, at the time, at the same time.

sentences.text: Jasur can't answer the phone **at the moment** because he's in a job interview.
sentences.translation: Jasur **hozir** telefonni ko'tara olmaydi, chunki ish suhbatida o'tiribdi.

sentences.text: **At present** about two hundred people work for the company in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: **Hozirgi paytda** kompaniyada Toshkentda ikki yuzga yaqin xodim ishlaydi.

sentences.text: I was living in Manchester **at the time**, so I didn't hear about the flood.
sentences.translation: **O'sha paytda** Manchesterda yashardim, shuning uchun suv toshqini haqida eshitmadim.

sentences.text: Do you visit your parents **at the weekend**, or do they come to you?
sentences.translation: **Dam olish kunlari** ota-onangiznikiga borasizmi yoki ular sizga kelishadimi?

sentences.text: **At weekends** Oliver works in a café to pay for his university course.
sentences.translation: **Har dam olish kunlari** Oliver universitet o'qishiga pul to'lash uchun kafeda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Flights to Europe always become more expensive **at Christmas** and **at Easter**.
sentences.translation: Yevropaga aviachiptalar **Rojdestvoda** va **Pasxada** doim qimmatlashadi.

sentences.text: My whole family gathers at my grandmother's house in Fergana **at New Year**.
sentences.translation: **Yangi yil bayramida** butun oilam Farg'onadagi buvimning uyida yig'iladi.

sentences.text: Two customers walked in **at the same time**, and both wanted the last table.
sentences.translation: Ikki mijoz **bir vaqtda** kirib keldi va ikkalasi ham oxirgi stolni so'radi.

sentences.text: Why does my laptop always crash **at the worst possible moment**?
sentences.translation: Nega noutbukim doim **eng noqulay paytda** ishdan chiqadi?

sentences.text: **At the time of** the accident, the driver was talking on his phone.
sentences.translation: Avariya **sodir bo'lgan paytda** haydovchi telefonda gaplashayotgan edi.

examples.title: **on**: a particular day, even with part of it
examples.description: on — bitta aniq kun: sana, hafta kuni, bayram kuni. Kun qismi aniq kunga bog'lansa ham on: on Saturday evening, on the morning of the exam, on a cold winter evening.

sentences.text: The new metro station near our house will open **on 15 October**.
sentences.translation: Uyimiz yaqinidagi yangi metro bekati **15-oktabrda** ochiladi.

sentences.text: We're having a small party for Madina **on Saturday evening** — can you come?
sentences.translation: **Shanba kuni kechqurun** Madina uchun kichik ziyofat qilyapmiz — kela olasanmi?

sentences.text: Emma was born **on Christmas Day**, so she gets presents only once a year.
sentences.translation: Emma **Rojdestvo kuni** tug'ilgan, shuning uchun sovg'ani yiliga faqat bir marta oladi.

sentences.text: **On the morning of** the exam, Bekzod couldn't eat anything at all.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **kuni ertalab** Bekzod umuman hech narsa yeya olmadi.

sentences.text: It happened **on a cold winter evening**, soon after I had moved to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Bu Edinburgga ko'chib kelganimdan ko'p o'tmay, **sovuq qish oqshomlarining birida** sodir bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Does the gym stay open **on public holidays**, or is it closed?
sentences.translation: Sport zali **bayram kunlari** ochiq turadimi yoki yopiqmi?

sentences.text: **On my first day** at the new job, nobody told me where the kitchen was.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishdagi **birinchi kunimda** hech kim menga oshxona qayerdaligini aytmadi.

sentences.text: Most of our customers place their orders online **on Fridays**.
sentences.translation: Mijozlarimizning ko'pchiligi buyurtmalarni **juma kunlari** onlayn beradi.

sentences.text: Uzbekistan celebrates its Independence Day **on 1 September** with concerts and fireworks.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston Mustaqillik kunini **1-sentabrda** konsertlar va mushakbozlik bilan nishonlaydi.

sentences.text: Why did you send that email **on Sunday night** instead of waiting until Monday?
sentences.translation: Nega o'sha xatni dushanbani kutmasdan, **yakshanba kuni kechasi** yubording?

examples.title: **in**: decades, centuries, the past and the future
examples.description: in — ichida yashash mumkin bo'lgan uzun davr: oy va yil, fasl, o'n yillik, asr; in the past, in the future, in the Middle Ages, in the summer holidays.

sentences.text: My parents met at university **in the 1980s**, when there were no mobile phones.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam universitetda **1980-yillarda**, hali mobil telefonlar yo'q paytda tanishishgan.

sentences.text: Most of the madrasas in Khiva were built **in the 18th and 19th centuries**.
sentences.translation: Xivadagi madrasalarning aksariyati **XVIII–XIX asrlarda** qurilgan.

sentences.text: **In the past**, people wrote long letters; now they send voice messages.
sentences.translation: **Ilgari** odamlar uzun xatlar yozishardi, endi esa ovozli xabar yuborishadi.

sentences.text: Nobody knows what jobs will exist **in the future**, so flexible skills matter more.
sentences.translation: **Kelajakda** qanday kasblar bo'lishini hech kim bilmaydi, shuning uchun moslashuvchan ko'nikmalar muhimroq.

sentences.text: Tashkent can be unbearably hot **in summer**, so many families go to the mountains.
sentences.translation: Toshkent **yozda** chidab bo'lmas darajada issiq bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun ko'p oilalar tog'ga ketadi.

sentences.text: **In the Middle Ages**, Samarkand was one of the richest cities on the Silk Road.
sentences.translation: **O'rta asrlarda** Samarqand Buyuk Ipak yo'lidagi eng boy shaharlardan biri edi.

sentences.text: Kate is planning to travel round Asia **in the summer holidays**.
sentences.translation: Keyt **yozgi ta'tilda** Osiyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni rejalashtiryapti.

sentences.text: London house prices rose sharply **in the 2010s**, especially in the centre.
sentences.translation: London uy-joy narxlari **2010-yillarda**, ayniqsa markazda, keskin oshdi.

sentences.text: Was the company more successful **in its early years**?
sentences.translation: Kompaniya **dastlabki yillarida** muvaffaqiyatliroq bo'lganmi?

sentences.text: Our daughter starts school **in September 2027**, so we're looking for a flat nearby.
sentences.translation: Qizimiz **2027-yil sentabrda** maktabga boradi, shuning uchun yaqin atrofdan kvartira qidiryapmiz.

examples.title: **at night**, **in the night**, **in the morning**
examples.description: at night — umuman kechalari; in the night — aniq bir kechaning ichida; kelasi zamonda in the morning — ertaga ertalab; hafta kuni bilan — on Friday night.

sentences.text: I don't like driving **at night** because the headlights of other cars hurt my eyes.
sentences.translation: **Kechalari** mashina haydashni yoqtirmayman, chunki boshqa mashinalarning faralari ko'zimni og'ritadi.

sentences.text: The baby woke up twice **in the night**, so we're both exhausted today.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **tunda** ikki marta uyg'ondi, shuning uchun bugun ikkalamiz ham holdan toyganmiz.

sentences.text: Somebody broke into the corner shop **in the middle of the night**.
sentences.translation: **Yarim kechasi** kimdir muyulishdagi do'konga o'g'irlikka tushdi.

sentences.text: Don't worry about the report now — I'll send it to you **in the morning**.
sentences.translation: Hozir hisobot haqida qayg'urmang — uni sizga **ertaga ertalab** yuboraman.

sentences.text: Nilufar feels much more creative **in the evening** than **in the morning**.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **ertalabdan** ko'ra **kechqurun** o'zini ancha ijodkorroq his qiladi.

sentences.text: **On Friday night** we usually order pizza and watch a film together.
sentences.translation: **Juma kuni kechasi** odatda pitsa buyurtma qilib, birga kino ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: Did you hear the storm **in the night**? The wind was incredibly loud.
sentences.translation: **Kechasi** bo'ronni eshitdingmi? Shamol nihoyatda qattiq edi.

sentences.text: Many nurses at the hospital work **at night** and sleep during the day.
sentences.translation: Shifoxonadagi ko'plab hamshiralar **kechalari** ishlab, kunduzi uxlashadi.

sentences.text: The airport is surprisingly busy **in the early hours of the morning**.
sentences.translation: Aeroport **tong otmasdan oldingi soatlarda** kutilmaganda gavjum bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Grandpa always has a cup of green tea in the garden **on Sunday afternoons**.
sentences.translation: Bobom **yakshanba kunlari tushdan keyin** doim bog'da bir piyola ko'k choy ichadi.

examples.title: No preposition: **next month**, **that evening**
examples.description: next, last, this, every, each, one, that, all oldidan va the next day, tomorrow morning kabi iboralarda predlog yo'q. on Friday — shu juma, next Friday — ko'pincha kelasi hafta jumasi.

sentences.text: We're moving to a bigger flat **next month**, so I'm packing **every evening**.
sentences.translation: **Kelasi oy** kattaroq kvartiraga ko'chyapmiz, shuning uchun **har kech** narsalarni yig'yapman.

sentences.text: Aziz passed his driving test **last Thursday**, on his third attempt.
sentences.translation: Aziz haydovchilik imtihonini **o'tgan payshanba** uchinchi urinishda topshirdi.

sentences.text: Are you doing anything **this weekend**, or are you just staying at home?
sentences.translation: **Shu dam olish kunlari** biror ish qilyapsanmi yoki shunchaki uyda qolasanmi?

sentences.text: **One day** I'd love to visit Edinburgh during the summer festival.
sentences.translation: **Bir kun kelib** Edinburgga yozgi festival paytida borishni juda xohlardim.

sentences.text: Our manager phones each of us **every Monday** to check how the project is going.
sentences.translation: Menejerimiz loyiha qanday ketayotganini bilish uchun **har dushanba** har birimizga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.

sentences.text: I met Sarah at a conference, and **the next day** we had lunch together.
sentences.translation: Sara bilan konferensiyada tanishdim va **ertasi kuni** birga tushlik qildik.

sentences.text: **That evening** nobody in the house could sleep because of the heat.
sentences.translation: **O'sha oqshom** jazirama tufayli uydagilarning hech biri uxlay olmadi.

sentences.text: Is the meeting **on Friday** or **next Friday**? — The Friday after this one.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **shu juma**dami yoki **kelasi hafta jumasida**mi? — Bundan keyingi jumada.

sentences.text: Madina spent **all day** at the library, but she still hasn't finished her essay.
sentences.translation: Madina **kun bo'yi** kutubxonada o'tirdi, lekin inshosini hali ham tugatmadi.

sentences.text: James phoned **yesterday afternoon** to say he'd be late **tomorrow morning**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **kecha tushdan keyin** qo'ng'iroq qilib, **ertaga ertalab** kechikishini aytdi.

examples.title: **in** ten minutes, **in** a week's time, **in** two hours
examples.description: in + muddat: 1) kelajakda — hozirdan shuncha vaqt o'tgach (in a week's time); 2) ishga ketgan vaqt (in under two hours). after + muddat — o'tmishdagi voqeada, within — «... ichida».

sentences.text: The pizza will be ready **in about twenty minutes**, so please wait at the table.
sentences.translation: Pitsa **taxminan yigirma daqiqadan keyin** tayyor bo'ladi, iltimos, stolda kutib turing.

sentences.text: Our holiday in Turkey starts **in a week's time**, and I haven't packed yet.
sentences.translation: Turkiyadagi ta'tilimiz **bir haftadan keyin** boshlanadi, men esa hali narsalarimni yig'madim.

sentences.text: **In three months' time** Jasur will be a qualified engineer.
sentences.translation: **Uch oydan keyin** Jasur diplomli muhandis bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Emma ran the Edinburgh half marathon **in under two hours**.
sentences.translation: Emma Edinburg yarim marafonini **ikki soatdan kamroq vaqtda** yugurib o'tdi.

sentences.text: Can you really learn basic Spanish **in a month**? — It depends on how hard you work.
sentences.translation: Rostdan ham ispan tili asoslarini **bir oyda** o'rganish mumkinmi? — Qanchalik qattiq ishlashingizga bog'liq.

sentences.text: The builders promised to finish our kitchen **in ten days**, but it took six weeks.
sentences.translation: Quruvchilar oshxonamizni **o'n kunda** tugatishga va'da berishdi, lekin olti hafta ketdi.

sentences.text: We waited at the gate, and **after forty minutes** they finally announced the delay.
sentences.translation: Chiqish eshigi oldida kutdik va **qirq daqiqadan so'ng** nihoyat kechikish haqida e'lon qilishdi.

sentences.text: I'll call you back **in five minutes** — I'm just getting off the train.
sentences.translation: Senga **besh daqiqadan keyin** qayta qo'ng'iroq qilaman — hozir poyezddan tushyapman.

sentences.text: Doctors say the bone should heal completely **within six weeks**.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, suyak **olti hafta ichida** butunlay bitib ketishi kerak.

sentences.text: The new bridge was built **in just eighteen months**, which surprised everyone.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik **atigi o'n sakkiz oyda** qurildi, bu hammani hayratda qoldirdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a trip to Samarkand
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st sayohatni rejalashtiradi — at, on, in va predlogsiz vaqt iboralari bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Hi Oliver! When are you arriving in Tashkent — **on Thursday** or **on Friday**?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Oliver! Toshkentga qachon kelasan — **payshanba kuni**mi yoki **juma kuni**mi?

sentences.text: — **On Thursday**, but my plane lands quite late, **at about eleven at night**.
sentences.translation: — **Payshanba kuni**, lekin samolyotim ancha kech, **kechasi soat o'n birlarda** qo'nadi.

sentences.text: — No problem. We can take the fast train to Samarkand **the next morning**.
sentences.translation: — Muammo yo'q. **Ertasi kuni ertalab** Samarqandga tezyurar poyezdda boramiz.

sentences.text: — Great! Is it very hot there **in May**, or is the weather pleasant?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! U yerda **mayda** juda issiq bo'ladimi yoki havo yoqimlimi?

sentences.text: — It's usually warm during the day but quite cool **at night**.
sentences.translation: — Odatda kunduzi iliq, lekin **kechalari** ancha salqin bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Perfect. I'd love to see the Registan **at sunset** if possible.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Iloji bo'lsa, Registonni **kun botayotganda** ko'rishni juda xohlardim.

sentences.text: — Sure, and there's a light show there **on Saturday evenings** too.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, u yerda **shanba kunlari kechqurun** yorug'lik shousi ham bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Brilliant. My flight home is **on the 14th**, so we have plenty of time.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Uyga reysim **14-sanada**, demak vaqtimiz yetarli.

sentences.text: — Then let's book the tickets now — the trains get full **at weekends**.
sentences.translation: — Unda chiptalarni hozir band qilaylik — **dam olish kunlari** poyezdlar to'lib ketadi.

sentences.text: — Good idea. I'll send you the money **in a few minutes**.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Pulni **bir necha daqiqadan keyin** yuboraman.
